entities.name: Maurice Van Den Bemden
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Maurice van den Bemden was a Belgian field hockey player and tennis player. He won a bronze medal at the 1920 Summer Olympics in Antwerp with the Belgium national field hockey team. He also competed in tennis at the 1920 Summer Olympics.
